anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After delivers the Change cleanly and moves every fact from fails to holds: Before rejected the course model outright (no deliver verb, bare 2 mapped to review, cap 5 not 10, no in-loop sync or rebase, own pushes never renewing the deadline), so it stopped at a BEHIND wait menu, never requested a re-run in C, and had no sync lease/restore heads in D. After maps the single numeric 2 to deliver, repairs P1 and CI-minted P2 with fresh helpers and closure review with no mid-menu, renews the window on each own push (12:17, 12:25, 12:27) while explicitly noting the 12:11 base move renews nothing, auto-syncs on BEHIND with pre_head/expected_remote_head persisted and syncs_used charged separately, renders final with merge offered but not executed, exits B and C as stuck on repeated red with exactly one re-run in C and no base-only movement counted as source change, and in D leases against remote A, restores clean B after refusal, and makes no second push. Nothing regressed; one small tightening would be to keep the compact table in the main sequence from carrying narrative prose in the Outcome cells, and to state in Checkpoint B's table that syncs_used 1/10 is the restored value rather than a new charge, so a reader cannot mistake the restore for an increment.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After delivers the course model well: the single numeric 2 opens a persistent deliver course, P1 and CI-minted P2 are repaired without an intermediate menu, BEHIND syncs automatically, final offers merge but executes nothing on stop, B and C exit on repeated red with correct source-change reasoning, and D persists pre_head B / expected_remote_head A, leases against A and restores B. The one miss is f2: After ties deadline initialization to the first bounded watch ('null' after the 12:02 push, 'null at push; 12:25 at first watch' for 12:10) rather than to the own push itself, so the required 12:02→12:17 renewal never appears and the 12:10 window is only incidentally 12:25. The Change text says timeout 'renews only on own push', which After reads as a necessary condition but not a sufficient one. Reword to make every own push set the window unconditionally, e.g. 'each successful own push sets poll_deadline to push time plus the configured timeout (12:02→12:17, 12:10→12:25, 12:12→12:27), whether or not a watch is pending; base-only observations and base-sync SHA movement never touch it.' That keeps every fact After already holds (no mid-menu, automatic sync, B/C exits, D restore/lease separation) while recording the three own-push deadlines the scenario asks for.
